# coderforge_storage (Resource)

A virtual disk, optionally attached to a machine.

Attachment is an attribute of the disk rather than a resource of its own, so one apply creates a disk and gives it to a machine. Moving it to another machine detaches and reattaches in place, without destroying the data.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A detached disk, ready to be attached later or handed to a container service.
resource "coderforge_storage" "archive" {
  name    = "archive"
  size_gb = 200
}

# A disk attached to a machine on SATA port 1. Moving it to another machine is
# an in-place detach and reattach; the data survives.
resource "coderforge_storage" "database" {
  name        = "database-data"
  size_gb     = 100
  attached_to = coderforge_machine.db.name
  port        = 1
}

resource "coderforge_machine" "db" {
  name = "db01"
  cpu  = 4
  ram  = 8192
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Disk name, unique across the platform. Renaming replaces the disk.
- `size_gb` (Number) Size in GiB, between 1 and 500. The platform cannot resize a disk, so changing this destroys and recreates it, losing the contents.

### Optional

- `attached_to` (String) Name of the machine to attach the disk to. Omit to leave it detached, or to hand the disk to a `coderforge_container_service`, which attaches it to its own nodes and owns that attachment. Requires `port`.
- `port` (Number) SATA port to attach on, between 0 and 30. Required with `attached_to`, and unique per machine.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the disk was created.
- `id` (String) Cloud Builder resource id, for example `store:0003`.
- `managed_by` (String) Set when a container service owns this disk. A disk with an owner must not be managed directly.
- `path` (String) Path of the disk image on the hypervisor host.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# A disk is identified by its resource id.
terraform import coderforge_storage.archive store:0003
```
